manual_review.configuration: Both arms log DP=8, TP=1, enabled expert parallelism, BF16 and max_model_len=32768, V2 Model Runner, AgRsAll2AllManager, FlashAttention 3 and TRITON Unquantized MoE. ON adds native EPLB with 32 redundant experts and explicitly selects TorchDistGlooStagedEplbCommunicator. No custom dispatcher is installed.
manual_review.eplb: ON has three ordinary async launch log entries, separate from one profiling rearrangement. The logs do not prove successful normal all-layer commit or rank-agreed committed maps. Drain and shutdown are not commit certificates.
manual_review.jit: All eight recorded JIT warnings across the pair are compatible with smoke only. No calibration or external warning was observed. This is warning-based phase attribution, not measured compilation duration or proof every possible shape is warm.
manual_review.limitations: The diagnostic reuses ShareGPT content and runs OFF before ON once; it does not supply independent content generalization, run-level uncertainty or a fixed-generated-work speedup. No dataset pooling is appropriate.
manual_review.reproduction: Use full_serving.audit_runtime.audit_cohort(Path("results/full-serving/pilots-v1/sharegpt-burstgpt-diagnostic")) to regenerate parsed evidence. Ordinary launch compatible_phases use read_phase intervals with a ±1-second allowance. Configuration comparisons use the referenced per-node runtime-preflight JSONs.
manual_review.requests: Both OFF and ON completed 8 smoke, 32 calibration, and 24 external requests, with zero recorded request failures and all SSE DONE markers. Input/calendar/client hashes match within the pair. Generated work differs between arms.
manual_review.shutdown: Both arms contain eight ERROR/traceback log lines only after explicit same-file shutdown markers. Final external request end is approximately 17:16:11.615 UTC OFF and 17:26:03.852 UTC ON; log timestamps have one-second precision. Both use abort timeout=0 and force-kill remaining engines. These are teardown errors; no earlier runtime error or async-loop error is recorded. Request completion does not establish a graceful shutdown or committed expert state.
